title: Vegetarian Japanese-Style Rice Bowl
description: A simple and flavorful vegetarian Japanese-inspired rice bowl dish. This recipe is perfect for a quick and easy lunch or dinner.
instructions: Cook the Japanese rice according to the package instructions. Typically, it's a 1:1 ratio of water to rice.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tablespoon of yummy sauce over medium heat.
Add the sliced shiitake mushrooms and cook until they're tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced carrots and bell peppers to the pan and cook for another 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon of yummy sauce and cook for 1 minute.
To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of cooked Japanese rice in the bottom of a bowl.
Add the sautéed vegetables on top of the rice.
Sprinkle chopped green onions and sesame seeds over the top, if using.
